name: vfmaq_f32
description: Floating-point fused Multiply-Add to accumulator (vector). This instruction multiplies corresponding floating-point values in the two source vectors, adds the product to the destination element, and writes the result.

instructions.preamble: This intrinsic compiles to the following instructions:

name: vfmaq_f64
description: Floating-point fused Multiply-Add to accumulator (vector). This instruction multiplies corresponding floating-point values.

name: vld4q_s8
description: Load multiple 4-element structures to four registers. This instruction loads multiple 4-element structures from memory, with de-interleaving.

name: vtbx1_s8
description: Table vector lookup extension. This instruction reads permutation indices and selects bytes.

name: vsubq_s32
description: Subtract (vector). This instruction subtracts the elements in the second source vector from the corresponding elements in the first source vector, and places the results in the destination vector.
